evidenceBoundary: The packed Companion runs in a real Playwright browser through ExtensionHost with deterministic local storage and model fixtures. This proves UI state, request payloads, retry/error handling, and persistence across reload. Import currently uses the browser file-input fallback because the host bridge does not expose window.ryu.ui.uploadFile; Playwright validates its accept/multiple constraints and file parsing, while OS picker chrome remains partial. Export proves the JSON Blob and download-link request; native download delivery remains partial because the manifest does not request files:download. It does not prove a live model provider, social-platform delivery, or scheduling; Studio currently has no connected publisher or scheduler.
